Title: Public preview: Multitasking in the cost analysis preview

Body.Content:
Azure Cost Management is introducing a new cost analysis experience to help you better analyze and get insights on your cost. The public preview includes a new tabbed experience to streamline analysis as you drill into costs. You start with a list of the built-in views and can open multiple tabs to explore different aspects of your costs simultaneously.

Explore the new cost analysis experience in Azure portal today.
